== Game mechanics ==
* This enchantment spell can be maintained at 0 spawning power, i.e. it can be used effectively by non-primary ritualist characters. 
** Does not work with [[Weapon of Aggression]], since it only self-targets.
** Does not work with [[Weapons of Three Forges]], since it does not target an ally.

== Notes ==
* The shortest recharging weapon spell (with a recharge time of 1s) is [[Ghostly Weapon]]. Since the rank in [[Communing]] affects only Ghostly Weapon's duration, it can be used effectively even at 0 Communing. Other short recharging item spells are [[Vital Weapon]] (2s), [[Vengeful Weapon]], [[Weapon of Remedy]] and [[Xinrae's Weapon]] (3s). The activation time is of 1/4s for all those skills except Vital Weapon (1s). Other weapon spells that synergize with Wielder's Remedy have a recharge time of at least 5s for a casting time of 1s.
